title: R20 delegates a brand title slot to the brand step when the kit names its page instead of its block
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A name slot with block equal to the page passes R20; one naming another page fails; existing delegation failures stay failures.

tests: a brand title slot whose kit names its page instead of its block is still the brand step’s
brand delegation never excuses a hidden title, dropped block, wrong block or unknown name-slot ID
